name: What types of windows are best for energy efficiency in Southern California?

mainEntity.name: What types of windows are best for energy efficiency in Southern California?

acceptedAnswer.text: For Southern California's climate, dual-pane or triple-pane windows with Low-E (low-emissivity) coatings are highly recommended. These features help reflect heat in the summer and retain warmth in the winter, significantly reducing your energy bills. Vinyl frames are also popular for their excellent insulation properties and durability, providing a cost-effective and energy-efficient solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Dual-pane or triple-pane windows with Low-E coatings are best for energy efficiency in Southern California, helping to regulate indoor temperatures year-round.
